name: camtrap-dp-rodent-example-metadataset
title: Camera trap based small rodent monitoring: Data from Norwegian alpine tundra
description:
Small rodents are a key species impacting all levels in the alpine tundra food-web. 
    In 2023 the Norwegian Institute of Nature Research established a national monitoring program for 
    small rodents based on camera trap in the Alpine Tunda on behalf of the Norwegian Enviroenmtal 
    Agency. Data from 5 mountain areas are available here. In each mountain area we cover the most 
    important habitat for small rodents (heath, hummock mire and snowbed) and two alpine zones 
    (low and mid alpine zone). We apply tunnel camera traps, developed and described by 
    Soininen et al. (2015) and the images captured are processed using the semi-automatic workflow 
    established by Böhner et al. (2023). Abundance indices can be estimated following temporal and 
    spatial aggregation of detection event following Kleiven et al. 2023. See Kleiven et. al. 2022 
    for further details about the monitoring program.
